g.text: Same-root edge: independent source and composition review
Two actual find traces reach the same root
Derive endpoint affine equations and subtract both signed offsets
True edge excludes inconsistent zero coefficient; an answer equals k
Equal coefficients: invert +2 or -2, then anchor
Absent anchor is stored; repeated anchor compares old-minus-new coefficients
Global validity and post-find forest preserved
Independent controls include signed k offsets, both branches and invalid boundaries
6 main + 12 producer controls + 15 independent controls = 33 readbacks
Field/state model; native word/inverse/counter interfaces remain explicit
